action-order coverage.detail: all 24 regimes contain multiple frozen action presentation orders

action-order permutation.detail: adaptive outcome/resource signatures invariant in 6/6 family representatives after reversing presentation order

cost integrity.detail: trace costs, componentwise budgets, and evaluator totals agree across 7280 runs

deterministic replay.detail: exact public replay passed for 8008/8008 oracle and policy traces

evaluator firewall.detail: public projections omit truth/realization fields; a hidden-state probe fails; evaluator policies and invalid truth tokens are rejected

failed-run preservation.detail: artifacts retain 265 failed actions and 144 environment terminations; validity remains explicit

future-result blindness.detail: normal policies receive separate policy-only randomness plus distributions, never the environment seed, RNG slot, or sampled future result

hidden-state permutation.detail: adaptive outcome/resource signatures invariant in 6/6 family representatives after permuting hypothesis rows and labels

identifier scrambling.detail: adaptive outcome/resource signatures invariant in 6/6 family representatives after renaming hypotheses, actions, and outcomes

matched public model access.detail: all normal policies received the same public prior, declared likelihoods, costs, legal actions, released history, and budget projection

observation release.detail: all released observations carry step and result provenance across 7280 runs

opaque identifiers.detail: action IDs are opaque and contain no hypothesis-target labels

seed isolation.detail: population, hidden environment realization, and policy randomness use named domains; evaluator seeds are restricted, policy seeds are public, and perturbing the environment seed leaves random-policy routing unchanged
